# Reusable triage replies

Copy a reply into a GitHub saved reply if useful. Replace bracketed placeholders with the specific
answer or issue before posting. These are for manual triage, not automatic closure of possible bugs.

## Covered by a support answer

Thanks for checking in. This is covered by [answer title](ANSWER_URL).
Foqos is maintained in my spare time, and I can't provide individual setup support, so I'm closing
this as a support question. If you find different, reproducible behavior after following that answer,
use the bug-report form and include the steps you tried and what happened.

## Duplicate or existing feature decision

Thanks for the suggestion. This is already tracked or answered in #ISSUE_NUMBER, so I'm closing this
duplicate. Please read that discussion first; add a comment there only if you have new evidence or a
use case it does not already cover.

## Unverified automated report

Thanks for your interest in contributing. Reports need human verification before submission; please
see [the contribution guidelines](https://github.com/awaseem/foqos/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
I'm closing this unverified report. For a future report, include observed behavior and reproduction
steps, or measurements and a reproducible workload for a performance claim. Please keep agent
experiments local.
